answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pigment of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The nectar holds work receipts rather than names, so the voyage of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
